notes.title: The Queen
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41123887/3b3e7c35d60a0f0e6a7958b70587f888232b66a5.png[/img]


[i]Born in 1979, in the outskirts of Centropolis, Maria never liked the beach. Too much sand. When she touched the crystal for the first time, her clothes were filled with the sands of the Saara and she was very mad. An ancient egyptian spirit possessed Maria and demanded that she enslaved all Humanity to build mighty pyramids in her honor. But Maria had only one thing to say to this ancient spirit:

- Bitch, please. [/i]
